same_queue_barrier_proves: Transport callback was processed; it does not prove successful navigation, page readiness or world installation
rejection: Complete original Message once with a null WebView; never re-send after an uncertain effect
adoption: Fresh attached unnavigated child, original transport, no loadUrl replay; HTTP-only initial popup navigation is not guaranteed by this callback
isolated_world: Popup replaces the child's native contents. No popup document world is installed or claimed qualified yet
